description_for_human: Coupa MCP Server provides access to procurement workflows.
description_for_model: Use for Coupa downstream procurement workflows after a request exists, including invoices, purchase orders, requisitions, receipts, suppliers, approvals, category manager dashboards, supplier performance, item demand, stock coverage, and ServiceNow-to-Coupa request flow tracing. Do not use Coupa for employee laptop ordering, IT service catalog browsing, or the initial employee order form; those belong in ServiceNow.

functions.name: get_invoice_status
functions.description: Get invoice payment status from Coupa by invoice number (mocked).

functions.description: Get purchase order status from Coupa by PO number (mocked).

functions.description: Close a purchase order in Coupa (mocked).

functions.name: list_receipts
functions.description: List goods receipts from Coupa, optionally filtered by PO (mocked).

functions.name: prepare_create_receipt
functions.description: Show the goods receipt creation form for a PO (mocked).

functions.description: Post a goods receipt in Coupa (mocked).

functions.description: List purchase requisitions from Coupa (mocked).

functions.description: Show the purchase requisition creation form (mocked).

functions.name: create_requisition
functions.description: Submit a new purchase requisition in Coupa (mocked).

functions.name: approve_reject
functions.description: Approve or reject a pending approval in Coupa (mocked). Set action to 'approve' or 'reject'.

functions.name: get_category_manager_dashboard
functions.description: Category manager dashboard for ServiceNow-sourced IT hardware orders in Coupa (mocked).

functions.name: list_it_hardware_orders
functions.description: List ServiceNow-originated IT hardware purchase orders in Coupa with category, supplier, and delivery filters (mocked).

functions.name: get_supplier_performance
functions.description: Supplier performance dashboard for Coupa IT hardware suppliers (mocked).

functions.name: get_item_demand
functions.description: Item demand and stock coverage for phones, laptops, accessories, and office equipment in Coupa (mocked).

functions.description: Trace ServiceNow employee requests through Coupa requisitions, POs, receipts, and invoices (mocked).
